critical_code_review_comments: case_study.py:283-296 — validation logic is clean: box_speed range check uses inclusive 0.5..2.0, box_stagger 0..200 inclusive, per-section map validates both section key (against BOX_SECTIONS) and animation value (against BOX_ANIMS) with the correct error strings 'Entrance speed must be between 0.5x and 2x', 'Stagger must be between 0 and 200ms', 'Unknown section: <k>', 'Unknown box entrance animation'. Empty-value stripping happens before persistence so an empty string genuinely clears the override rather than storing ''.

AnimationControls.tsx — 429 retry (single, 1.3s delay) still present at lines 52-61. Good. Sliders save on release (onMouseUp/onTouchEnd), preventing every intermediate value from generating a PUT (reduces 429 pressure). Consider also adding onKeyUp for keyboard users adjusting via arrow keys.

boxAnims.ts — TEMPLATE_ANIM has 33 unique values (all distinct). sectionAnimFor uses coprime multipliers (7 and 3 with mod 38), guaranteeing that within a template all 9 sections get distinct animations and that the same section cycles through 33 unique values across templates — matches the 'each template ships a distinct combination' requirement.
Portal.tsx uses the same AnimationControls component the agency side uses (DRY). Non-member permission is enforced by the backend PUT (test_unauth_cannot_write_site_mode passes).
